reply.text:
This sounds like a shoulder pain question, and that one is for a doctor or physio, not a coach. I can't tell you what's going on with the shoulder or whether it's safe to keep loading it.

What I can do is build the training around it. Tell me which overhead movements bother you (press, pull-ups, something else) and I'll set the program up to leave those out, and we'll see what you can still do pain-free. If you want to swap a specific exercise in a program you're already running, name the exercise and what you'd like it replaced with, and I'll make that change for you.
